correctness.rationale: The permutation-only automorphism reduction is proved directly. A commuting transposition has exactly 2^(2n-3)|GL_(n-2)(2)| invertible matrices; support-s permutation codimension is at least s(n-s/2), yielding a negligible sum for s>=3. Products of distinct transpositions give codimension at least 4n-8, so Bonferroni gives sharp probability and conditional C2. Exhaustive independent binary enumeration n=2,3,4 confirms finite identities.
